committee.sub: Morning brief · Wednesday 30 September 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Spend eased to $119.09 from $146.19 last week and CPC sits at $5.95, but conversions are still zero with 73 clicks banked since the 8 Sept restart, short of the 150-click stop-loss mark.
Budget lost share (23.1%) remains below rank lost (71.9%), so the budget conversation has not opened; impression share is 10% while CTR slipped to 3.1% from 4.1% prior week.
Sessions fell 26% (39 vs 53) and calculator use dropped to 0 from 1, even though /ai-automation-agency.html still leads landing pages with 17 sessions.

AI Assistant sessions held at 2, all via chatgpt.com, though this undercounts clicks landing as Direct; Organic Search nearly halved to 6 from 12, and LinkedIn dropped to 0 from 1, so any posting Chris did there was likely untagged. Search Console data only runs through 27 Sept, two days behind yesterday's Tue 29 count.

actions.text: Open item: logo and image assets plus keyword-matched RSA headlines are still needed for the serving ad groups.
